title: The Lantern with Two Handles
youtube_title: The Lantern with Two Handles | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a turn for someone else keeps the joy whole.
summary: At a picnic cloth in a calm meadow, Eko sees that a small lantern with room for two hands on the handle will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Eko makes a smaller, even share so Casper is included, and the baker lets the choice stand without a speech.
